newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tian An China shares down on dilution fear.
newsitem.headline: Tian An China shares down on dilution fear.

text.p: Shares of China property concern Tian An China Investments Co Ltd fell on dilution fears after the company announced a one-for-one rights issue plan, brokers said on Friday.
"Fear of dilution after the rights issue triggered the sell off," said a sale manager at a regional brokerage.
The company's shares fell HK$0.09 or 7.69 percent to HK$1.08 in mid-morning with 11.68 million shares changing hand.
Brokers said they expected the shares to gain support after narrowing the gap with the price of the rights share.
Tian An China said it aimed to raise HK$858 million through an issue of 879.85 million rights shares at HK$1.00 each.
It said the rights shares will be issued with warrants attached in the proportion of two warrants for every five rights shares offered.
